thread:
Asha Gomez: Quick alignment for next-week benchmark webinar (Thu 10am PT). Need final runbook covering: reg page copy + GDPR consent, Zoom config (captions + local backup), recording export pipeline, HubSpot routing rules, and 48h clip delivery. Also want one short 30s social teaser and one 1m highlight.
Tom Lee: I can take reg page + CTA A/B. Proposal: fields = name, work email, track (Product / Platform), opt-in checkbox. Add hidden utm_source. Keep it 3-4 fields max.
Marisol Ortiz: Zoom defaults: auto-record cloud, separate audio files, enable live transcript (English), require registration, passcode on. Set alt host to Ben. Waiting room OFF but restrict screen share to hosts.
Ben K: I'll be alt host and run local OBS backup recording. Also pre-create RTMP stream key in case we need a livestream fallback. I'll upload OBS MP4 to S3 after event.
Asha Gomez: GDPR/Privacy copy: "By registering you consent to receive event materials and follow-ups per our privacy policy." Link to policy and add boolean for marketing_opt_in.
OpsBot: Action: set retention policy cloud->72h then auto-copy to S3 archive. Flag: redact PII before public share.
Tom Lee: Reg page copy draft: "Live benchmark of Redwood Inference: real workloads, cost/latency tradeoffs, and engineering Q&A. 45 minutes + live Q&A. Recording & clips delivered within 48 hours." A/B variants: "Watch live" vs "See the demo".
Marisol Ortiz: Greenroom checklist (30m prior): mic check, camera check, captions test, screen-share demo flow, close slack/email, confirm alt host signed in. Producer = Tom, host = Asha, alt-host = Ben.
Ben K: Recording pipeline plan: Zoom cloud -> export MP4 + VTT -> S3 raw -> transcode -> clips job (0:00-0:30 teaser, 0:45-1:45 highlight) -> QC (manual) -> push to HubSpot assets. I'll tag with event_id=3270004321.
Asha Gomez: Lead routing: Attendees who watch >=10 min OR send chat/question = engaged. Hot lead = engaged AND (job_title contains engineer|infra|product OR company in target_list). Hot -> SDR alert + assign in HubSpot within 24h. Non-attendee registrants -> nurture sequence.
HubSpotBot: Reminder: create property webinar_engagement (enum: registered, attended, engaged) and webinar_hot_lead (bool). Also create workflow: registrant -> attendee flag -> engagement calc -> hot lead assignment.
Tom Lee: Post-event comms: T+48h send replay + 3-question survey (NPS, main takeaway, interest in trial). If survey_score high OR clicked clip -> escalate to SDR.
Marisol Ortiz: Captions backup plan: native Zoom captions + Otter.ai live captions via webhook. Run 2-min caption accuracy check in greenroom. If accuracy < 85% use Rev.ai post-process before publish.
Ben K: Permissions & access: recordings downloadable by ops & producer for first 72h. After redaction/QC, move to Marketing share folder. PII removal step left to Ops.
Asha Gomez: Risk table: missing cloud file -> fetch local OBS from Ben within 6h -> if missing escalate to infra for RTMP logs. Metadata: record event_id & S3 path on publish.
OpsBot: Logged: event_id=3270004321, archive_rule=cloud->s3->immutable, backup_contact=Ben K, sla_local_backup=6h.
Tom Lee: Owners: reg page & copy = Tom, Zoom ops = Marisol, backups & ingest = Ben, HubSpot workflows = Asha. Promo assets = Tom+Marisol.
Asha Gomez: Final: please react :white_check_mark: if you own your item and report blockers. I'll compile final runbook and post here.
Ben K: :white_check_mark: uploading RTMP key to event vault.
Marisol Ortiz: :white_check_mark: captions & alt-host set.
Tom Lee: :white_check_mark: reg page live, A/B switched.
Asha Gomez: Thanks team 680 see you in greenroom.
